Olio is a local sharing app for passing on things you don’t need to people who live nearby.

From food and clothes to books and toys, turn your useless into someone else’s useful on Olio — and help fight waste. 

Give and get for free; lend and borrow for free; or buy and sell pre-loved items. 

Join a global community of 7 million Olio-ers making a difference in their local communities, and for our planet. 

> Declutter your home, fast: free items usually requested in under 2 hours
> Feel good: 2 in 3 Olio-ers say sharing boosts their mental health
> Do good: Reducing waste is one of the best things you can do to fight climate change

How to use Olio
1: Snap 
Add a photo of your item and set a pick-up location
2: Message
Check your messages and arrange pick up — either on your doorstep, in a public location, or hidden in a safe space
3: Share 
Soak up the good vibes knowing you’ve helped someone local, and the planet

Olio can be used anywhere in the world. Join our ‘share more, waste less’ movement today!
